<!-- GENERATED from templates/area.qmd by R/03_area_pages.R. Edit the template, not this file. The format is described in AREA_REPORTS.md. -->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "site_helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "area_helpers.R"))
NAME <- "@@NAME@@"; TIER <- "@@TIER@@"; LAS <- @@LAS@@; PARENT <- "@@PARENT@@"
V1_DOC <- "@@V1DOC@@"; SLUG <- "@@SLUG@@"
V <- load_va(); P <- load_place(); X <- load_area_v1(SLUG)
LADS <- readRDS(here::here("data", "sussex_lads.rds"))

# Comparators, as in the original documents: a district against its county
# and Brighton and Hove; an authority against the other two; Sussex against
# its three authorities
COMPS <- switch(TIER, region = LAS, la = setdiff(SUSSEX_LAS, NAME), district = c(PARENT, "Brighton and Hove"))

js <- P$abs_schools |> left_join(P$va_m2 |> filter(group == "all") |> select(URN, va_m2), by = "URN")
W <- va_wide(V) |> left_join(js, by = "URN") |>
  left_join(P$scenarios |> select(URN, gain_all, gain_dis), by = "URN")
in_area <- if (TIER == "district") W$lad %in% NAME else W$LANAME %in% LAS
w <- W[in_area, ] |> arrange(desc(va_shrunk_all))
lads <- if (TIER == "district") LADS[LADS$lad == NAME, ] else LADS[LADS$la %in% LAS, ]
n <- nrow(w)
names_ <- w |> select(URN, SCHNAME)

m <- function(g, ww = w) mean(ww[[paste0("va_shrunk_", g)]], na.rm = TRUE)
m_area <- function(a, g) if (a == NAME) m(g) else m(g, W[W$LANAME == a, ])
above <- sum(w$va_lo_all > 0, na.rm = TRUE); below <- sum(w$va_hi_all < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
la_at <- function(la, g) V$la |> filter(LANAME == la, group == g)
yrs <- V$spec$years
sh <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x)
FEW <- 4   # name schools in running text up to this many; beyond it, count them and point to a table
schools_txt <- function(k) if (k == 1) "1 school" else paste(k, "schools")
n_sig <- function(k, dir) if (k == 0) paste("none", dir) else paste(k, dir)
# Lower-case a component's first letter for running text, but not a proper noun
lc1 <- function(x) ifelse(grepl("^English", x), x, sub("^(.)", "\\L\\1", x, perl = TRUE))
# An outcome as it reads in a sentence
ow <- function(o) c("All pupils" = "all pupils", "Disadvantaged" = "disadvantaged pupils",
                    "Non-disadvantaged" = "non-disadvantaged pupils", "Absence (intake-adjusted)" = "absence")[o]
orig <- function(text, anchor = "") sprintf("[%s](%s/%s%s)", text, ORIGINAL_SITE, V1_DOC, anchor)
OFSTED_ONE  <- c("Report card" = "report card", "No overall grade" = "inspection with no overall grade",
                 "Graded" = "graded inspection", "Ungraded only" = "ungraded visit only")
OFSTED_MANY <- c("Report card" = "report cards", "No overall grade" = "inspections with no overall grade",
                 "Graded" = "graded inspections", "Ungraded only" = "ungraded visits only")
ofsted_txt_area <- function(k) { t <- table(factor(k, names(OFSTED_ONE))); t <- t[t > 0]
  and_list(sprintf("%d %s", as.vector(t), ifelse(as.vector(t) == 1, OFSTED_ONE[names(t)], OFSTED_MANY[names(t)]))) }

# Absence against intake for the area and its comparators (v2 stage 1)
abs_ex <- function(a) if (a == NAME) mean(w$abs_excess, na.rm = TRUE) else
  P$abs_la$excess[P$abs_la$LANAME == a]
over <- w |> filter(abs_excess > 1) |> arrange(desc(abs_excess))
under <- w |> filter(abs_excess < -1) |> arrange(abs_excess)

# The original project's absence and suspension data for the area
abs_last <- tail(X$abs_years, 1); abs_prev <- tail(X$abs_years, 2)[1]
ser <- X$abs_series
s_at <- function(a, tp, col = "abs_rate") ser[[col]][ser$area == a & ser$time_period == tp]
rs <- X$reasons |> filter(time_period == abs_last)
rs_w <- rs |> select(area, reason, pp) |> pivot_wider(names_from = area, values_from = pp)
r_at <- function(a, r) rs_w[[a]][rs_w$reason == r]
exa <- X$excl$area; ex_last <- max(exa$time_period)
ex_at <- function(a, col = "susp_rate") exa[[col]][exa$la_name == a & exa$time_period == ex_last]
ep <- susp_both(X$excl_schools)
rt_ratio <- r_at(NAME, "Reduced timetable") / r_at("England", "Reduced timetable")
sus_ratio <- ex_at(NAME) / ex_at("England")

# Place: the authority's v2 effect, and the v2 district test
area_lads <- if (TIER == "district") NAME else sort(unique(na.omit(w$lad)))
# A unitary authority is its own single district, so a district term there
# only duplicates the authority's: the test is skipped (as in v1)
UNITARY <- TIER == "la" && identical(area_lads, NAME)
deff <- P$district$effects |> filter(lad %in% area_lads, !lad %in% SUSSEX_LAS, outcome != "Non-disadvantaged", !UNITARY)
sig_lads <- function(s) deff |> filter(spec == s, sig) |>
  mutate(t = sprintf("%s for %s (%s%%)", lad, ow(outcome), sh(pct(effect)))) |> pull(t)
pub <- sig_lads("Published specification"); sch <- sig_lads("With a school term")

# Trusts that ran the area's schools in 2024/25, on the v2 trust model
TE <- P$trusts$effects |> mutate(name = tidy_trust(trust_group)) |> filter(name %in% w$run_by)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## About this page

Value Added v2.0 for `r NAME`'s state-funded secondary schools,
`r yl(min(yrs))` to `r yl(max(yrs))`, measured against England (see
[the method](@@ROOT@@method.qmd)), with the analyses of the original
`r orig("Sussex document")` refitted on the v2.0 model. Built from
published DfE and Ofsted data; nothing uses pupil-level records.
:::

```{r summary}
          else paste0("; ", nrow(over), " schools more than a point above")),
  with(as.list(plane_quadrants(w)), sprintf(

    sh(mean(w$va_m2, na.rm = TRUE)), good_both, n, despite, below_worse)),
  if (TIER == "la") {
    e <- la_at(NAME, "all"); ed <- la_at(NAME, "disadvantaged")

  },

    else paste0("**A district effect survives each school's own record:** ", and_list(sch), ".")
  },

          sprintf("%.1f", ex_at(NAME)), sprintf("%.1f", ex_at("England")), sprintf("%.1f", ep$pupil_rate),
          sprintf("%.1f", ex_at("England", "pupil_rate")), sprintf("%.1f", rt_ratio)),
  if (nrow(TE |> filter(sig))) paste0("**Trusts that stand out nationally on v2.0:** ",
    and_list(TE |> filter(sig) |> group_by(name) |>

    sh(mean(w$va_2526_all, na.rm = TRUE))))
cat(paste0("- ", b[!is.na(b) & nzchar(b)], collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

# Value added and attendance {#school-by-school}

Value Added v2.0 counts absence as part of a school's context: a school
with more absence is expected to score lower. The other view counts
attendance *in*: value added from the model without its absence term,
set beside how far each school's absence runs above or below what its
intake predicts. A school high on that chart adds value; one to the left
also holds attendance better than its intake would suggest.

```{r fig-plane}
#| fig-cap: "Every school in England on two signals, 2021/22 to 2024/25: absence above or below what its intake predicts, and Value Added v2.0 with attendance counted in (the model without its absence term). The area's schools in colour; hover for each school's figures, drag to zoom, double-click to reset."
#| fig-height: 6.5
fig_plane_live(js |> left_join(W |> select(URN, SCHNAME), by = "URN"), w)
```

`r with(as.list(plane_quadrants(w)), paste0("Of ", n, " schools, **", good_both, "** add value with attendance at or better than their intake predicts, and **", despite, "** add value despite worse attendance. **", below_worse, "** are below expectation with worse attendance, and **", below_better, "** are below expectation despite attendance at or better than predicted."))`
Across `r NAME`'s schools the two signals correlate at
`r sprintf("%.2f", cor(w$abs_excess, w$va_m2, use = "complete"))`
(`r sprintf("%.2f", cor(js$abs_excess, js$va_m2, use = "complete"))`
across England): schools whose absence runs below what their intake
predicts tend to add more.

```{r tbl-plane}

    transmute(g, School = SCHNAME, District = coalesce(lad, LANAME),
              `Attendance counted in` = sh(va_m2), `Absence vs intake` = sh(abs_excess),
              `Value added v2.0` = sh(va_shrunk_all), `Run by (2024/25)` = coalesce(run_by, ""))
  tt |> select(-g) |> kt(align = "llrrrl") |> kableExtra::pack_rows(index = table(factor(tt$g, unique(tt$g))))
}
```

# What `r NAME`'s schools add, and what absence takes away

```{r add-take-area-figures}
#| include: false
bA_ <- V$coefs$estimate[V$coefs$term == "log(PERCTOT)" & V$coefs$group == "all"]
bD_ <- V$coefs$estimate[V$coefs$term == "log(PERCTOT)" & V$coefs$group == "disadvantaged"]
m8_ <- V$summary$mean_att8[V$summary$group == "all"]
ab_eng <- mean(W$absence, na.rm = TRUE)
# Absence is converted through the national gradient, so an area with few
# schools is not asked to supply its own percentiles. Value added is already
# measured against England, so it needs no rebasing.
eff <- function(ww, lab) {
  a <- mean(ww$absence, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble::tibble(area = lab, k = nrow(ww), absence = a,
                 abs_pts = m8_ * (exp(bA_ * log(a / ab_eng)) - 1),
                 abs_pts_dis = m8_ * (exp(bD_ * log(a / ab_eng)) - 1),
                 va_pts = mean(ww$va_shrunk_all, na.rm = TRUE))
}
cmp <- dplyr::bind_rows(eff(w, NAME),
         dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(COMPS, function(a) eff(W[W$LANAME == a, ], a)))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(net = abs_pts + va_pts)
me <- cmp[cmp$area == NAME, ]
```

Value added already counts absence as part of a school's context, so what
absence moves and what the school moves are separate quantities rather
than one counted twice. Below, the blue bar is what this area's absence
is worth against the England average of
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", ab_eng)`, run through the national gradient; the
purple bar is the area's mean value added, which is measured against
England already. The diamond is the two together.

```{r fig-add-take-area}
#| fig-cap: !expr sprintf("%s and its comparators. Blue is what the area absence level is worth against the England average, through the national gradient. Purple is mean Value Added v2.0, which is measured against England already. The diamond is the two together, and zero is the England average.", NAME)
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: !expr max(3.1, 1.15 + 0.78 * nrow(cmp))
lv <- rev(cmp$area)
long <- cmp |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(abs_pts, va_pts), names_to = "part", values_to = "pts") |>
  dplyr::mutate(part = factor(ifelse(part == "abs_pts", "What absence moves",
                                     "What the schools move"),
                              levels = c("What absence moves", "What the schools move")),
                area = factor(area, levels = lv))

ggplot(long, aes(pts, area, fill = part)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linetype = "31", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.64) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.1f", pts),
                hjust = ifelse(pts < 0, 1.15, -0.15)),
            position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.74), size = 3.5, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::mutate(cmp, area = factor(area, levels = lv)),
             aes(net, area), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 23, size = 3.4,
             fill = "white", colour = INK, stroke = 1.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("What absence moves" = BLUE,
                               "What the schools move" = DPURPLE), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.16)) +
  labs(x = "Attainment 8 points against England", y = NULL) +
  theme_note(13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = ifelse(lv == NAME, "bold", "plain")))
```

`r NAME`'s schools run at `r sprintf("%.1f%%", me$absence)` absence
against England's `r sprintf("%.1f%%", ab_eng)`, which on the national
gradient is worth **`r sh(me$abs_pts)` Attainment 8 points**. Their mean
value added is **`r sh(me$va_pts)`**, so the two together leave the area
`r sh(me$net)` points against England.
`r if (me$abs_pts < 0 && me$va_pts > 0) sprintf("The schools are pulling against their attendance, and recovering %.0f%% of it.", 100 * min(me$va_pts / -me$abs_pts, 1)) else if (me$abs_pts > 0 && me$va_pts < 0) "Attendance is doing the area a favour its value added is not." else if (me$abs_pts < 0) "Both are pulling the same way, downwards." else "Both are pulling the same way, upwards."`

For disadvantaged pupils the same absence is worth
`r sh(me$abs_pts_dis)` points rather than `r sh(me$abs_pts)`: the
gradient is
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * (bD_ / bA_ - 1))` steeper for them, so
wherever attendance is the problem it is a sharper problem for the
pupils with least room to absorb it.

The gradient is associational. It says what schools with this much
absence look like once intake is accounted for, not what this area would
gain by changing it.

# How `r NAME` compares

```{r tbl-profile}
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0(NAME, " against ", and_list(COMPS), " and England, ", yl(X$latest_panel), ". Means of school-level figures; ", if (TIER == "district") "ranks among England's districts with five or more schools" else "ranks among all local authorities", " (1 = highest). Value added and absence against intake are v2.0, 2021/22 to 2024/25.")
latest <- X$latest_panel
prof <- X$profiles |> filter(year_label == latest)
ap <- X$area_profile |> filter(year_label == latest)
rank_of <- function(col) if (TIER == "district") district_rank(X$lad_profiles, latest, NAME, col)$r else
  if (TIER == "la") rank(-prof[[col]])[prof$LANAME == NAME] else NA
cell <- function(a, col, d = 1) {
  f <- function(x) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x)
  if (a == NAME) { r <- rank_of(col); paste0(f(ap[[col]]), if (!is.na(r)) paste0(" (", ord(r), ")") else "") }
  else f(prof[[col]][prof$LANAME == a])
}
eng <- function(col, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), weighted.mean(prof[[col]], prof$schools, na.rm = TRUE))
row <- function(lab, col, d = 1) tibble(Measure = lab, !!NAME := cell(NAME, col, d),
  !!!setNames(lapply(COMPS, function(a) cell(a, col, d)), COMPS), England = eng(col, d))
v2row <- function(lab, f, eng_txt = "0.0") tibble(Measure = lab, !!NAME := f(NAME),
  !!!setNames(lapply(COMPS, f), COMPS), England = eng_txt)
bind_rows(
  row("Attainment 8, all pupils", "att8"), row("Attainment 8, disadvantaged", "att8_dis"),
  row("Attainment 8, non-disadvantaged", "att8_non"), row("Disadvantage gap (points)", "gap"),
  row("Disadvantaged (FSM6) %", "fsm"), row("Overall absence %", "absence"),
  row("Persistent absence %", "persistent"), row("Mean KS2 (centred)", "ks2_c", 2), row("EAL %", "eal"),
  v2row("Value added v2.0, all pupils", function(a) sh(m_area(a, "all"))),
  v2row("Value added v2.0, disadvantaged", function(a) sh(m_area(a, "disadvantaged"))),
  v2row("Absence against intake (pp)", function(a) sh(abs_ex(a)))) |>
  kt(align = paste0("l", strrep("r", 2 + length(COMPS))))
```

# What explains attainment in `r NAME`

```{r decomp}
#| include: false
areas <- c(NAME, COMPS)
dec <- bind_rows(lapply(areas, function(a) {
  u <- if (a == NAME) w$URN else W$URN[W$LANAME == a]
  decompose(V, u, a)
})) |> mutate(area = factor(area, areas))
d_get <- function(a, g, comp) dec$points[dec$area == a & dec$group == g & dec$component == comp]
pieces <- function(a, g, min_abs = 0.25) dec |>
  filter(area == a, group == g, component != "Unexplained (school)", abs(points) >= min_abs) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(points)))
```

```{r fig-decomp}
#| fig-cap: !expr paste0("Why average Attainment 8 differs from England's, by factor, all school-years, on the v2.0 model, for ", and_list(areas), ". Approximate Attainment 8 points; the pieces sum to each panel's gap. 'Unexplained (school)' is the schools' own residual, before shrinkage and net of the authority and region effects.")
#| fig-height: !expr 1.4 + 3.2 * length(areas)
fig_decomp(dec)
```

```{r tbl-decomp}
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("The decomposition for ", NAME, ", Attainment 8 points.")
decomp_table(dec, NAME)
```

```{r decomp-text}
#| results: asis
for (g in c("All pupils", "Disadvantaged")) {
  p <- pieces(NAME, g); t <- sum(dec$points[dec$area == NAME & dec$group == g])
  cat(sprintf("**For %s**, %s is %.1f points %s England. The pieces of at least a quarter of a point:\n\n",
              ifelse(g == "All pupils", "all pupils", "disadvantaged pupils"), NAME, abs(t), ifelse(t >= 0, "above", "below")))
  if (nrow(p)) cat(paste0("- ", lc1(as.character(p$component)), " (", sprintf("%+.2f", p$points), ");", collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  cat(sprintf("- and the schools themselves (%+.2f).\n\n", d_get(NAME, g, "Unexplained (school)")))
}
```

# Place: authorities and districts

```{r fig-la}
#| fig-cap: "Local authority effects on the v2.0 model, all and disadvantaged pupils, every authority in England with a 95% interval. Sussex's authorities picked out."
#| fig-height: 5
V$la |>
  filter(group %in% c("all", "disadvantaged")) |>
  mutate(group = GROUP_LABELS[group], hl = ifelse(LANAME %in% c(LAS, COMPS), LANAME, "Other")) |>
  group_by(group) |> mutate(o = rank(effect)) |> ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(o, pct(effect))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GREY) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct(lo), ymax = pct(hi)), colour = LIGHT, width = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = LIGHT, size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = \(d) filter(d, hl != "Other"), aes(fill = hl), shape = 21, colour = "white", size = 3.2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = \(d) filter(d, hl != "Other"), aes(label = hl), size = 3, nudge_y = 3,
                           segment.colour = GREY) +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = AREA_COL, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Local authorities, ordered", y = "Effect (%)", title = NULL) +
  theme_note(10) + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

```{r bh-effect-note}
#| results: asis
if ("Brighton and Hove" %in% c(LAS, COMPS) && TIER != "district")
  cat("Brighton and Hove's large authority effect is almost all an absence effect: the city's schools attain what similar intakes attain elsewhere, despite unusually high, mostly illness, absence. See [Brighton and Hove's authority effect](@@ROOT@@bh_effect.qmd).\n")
```

The district test adds a district level to the v2.0 model, with and
without each school's own record. An effect that disappears once schools
are counted belongs to particular schools; one that survives is something
the district's schools share.

```{r fig-districts}
#| include: !expr nrow(deff) > 0
#| fig-cap: "District effects over and above each authority's, on the v2.0 model, with 95% intervals, without and with a school term."
#| fig-height: !expr max(2.6, 0.38 * length(area_lads) + 1.8)
if (nrow(deff)) fig_effects(deff, NULL)
```

`r if (UNITARY) paste0(NAME, " is a unitary authority, its own single district, so a district term would only duplicate the authority effect above; the test does not apply.") else if (!length(pub)) paste0("None of ", if (TIER == "district") NAME else paste0(NAME, "'s districts"), " has a district effect distinguishable from zero on the v2.0 model.") else if (!length(sch)) paste0("Without each school's own record: ", and_list(pub), ". With it, none remains: the differences belong to particular schools, not to the districts as places.") else paste0("Without each school's own record: ", and_list(pub), ". With it, ", and_list(sch), " remains: the nearest thing in the data to a genuine place effect.")`

```{r tbl-districts}
#| include: !expr TIER != "district"
#| tbl-cap: "Mean Value Added v2.0 and absence against intake by district (Attainment 8 points; percentage points)."
if (TIER != "district") {
  w |> group_by(District = lad) |>
    summarise(Schools = n(), `All pupils` = sh(mean(va_shrunk_all, na.rm = TRUE)),
              Disadvantaged = sh(mean(va_shrunk_disadvantaged, na.rm = TRUE)),
              Girls = sh(mean(va_shrunk_girls, na.rm = TRUE)), Boys = sh(mean(va_shrunk_boys, na.rm = TRUE)),
              `Absence vs intake` = sh(mean(abs_excess, na.rm = TRUE)),
              `Above / below` = paste(sum(va_lo_all > 0, na.rm = TRUE), "/", sum(va_hi_all < 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(District = ifelse(District == "Brighton and Hove", District,
                             sprintf('<a href="@@ROOT@@areas/%s.html">%s</a>', slug(District), District))) |>
    kt(align = "lrrrrrrr", escape = FALSE)
}
```

# The disadvantaged gap, and girls and boys

```{r fig-va}
#| fig-cap: "Each school's Value Added v2.0 against England with its 95% interval, for all, disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged pupils. Attainment 8 points, mean over the four years, shrunk by reliability."
#| fig-height: !expr max(3.2, 0.42 * n + 1.8)
fig_va(w, title = paste0(NAME, ": value added by school"))
```

```{r gap-notes}
#| include: false
gap_s <- w |> filter(va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged > 0, va_shrunk_disadvantaged < -1) |> arrange(va_shrunk_disadvantaged)
both <- w |> filter(va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged > 0, va_shrunk_disadvantaged > 0)
gb_gap <- w |> filter(!is.na(va_shrunk_girls), !is.na(va_shrunk_boys), abs(va_shrunk_girls - va_shrunk_boys) > 2)
```

Of `r nrow(w)` schools:

- **`r nrow(both)`** `r ifelse(nrow(both) == 1, "is", "are")` above expectation for both disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged pupils.
- **`r nrow(gap_s)`** `r ifelse(nrow(gap_s) == 1, "is", "are")` above expectation for non-disadvantaged pupils but more than a point below it for disadvantaged ones: the gap schools.
- **`r nrow(gb_gap)`** `r ifelse(nrow(gb_gap) == 1, "has", "have")` girls' and boys' value added more than two points apart.

```{r tbl-gap}
#| include: !expr nrow(gap_s) + nrow(both) > 0
#| tbl-cap: "Schools by the pattern of their disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged value added (Attainment 8 points against England, shrunk). The gap is non-disadvantaged minus disadvantaged."
gap_rows <- function(d, pattern) d |> transmute(Pattern = pattern, School = SCHNAME,
  Disadvantaged = sh(va_shrunk_disadvantaged), `Non-disadvantaged` = sh(va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged),
  Gap = sh(va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged - va_shrunk_disadvantaged))
gt <- bind_rows(gap_rows(gap_s, "Gap schools: above for non-disadvantaged, more than a point below for disadvantaged"),
                gap_rows(both |> arrange(desc(va_shrunk_disadvantaged)), "Above expectation for both groups"))
if (nrow(gt)) gt |> select(-Pattern) |> kt(align = "lrrr") |>
  kableExtra::pack_rows(index = table(factor(gt$Pattern, unique(gt$Pattern))))
```

```{r tbl-gb-gap}
#| include: !expr nrow(gb_gap) > 0
#| tbl-cap: "Schools where girls' and boys' value added differ by more than two points (Attainment 8 points against England, shrunk)."
if (nrow(gb_gap)) gb_gap |> mutate(d = va_shrunk_boys - va_shrunk_girls) |> arrange(desc(abs(d))) |>
  transmute(School = SCHNAME, Girls = sh(va_shrunk_girls), Boys = sh(va_shrunk_boys), `Boys minus girls` = sh(d)) |>
  kt(align = "lrrr")
```

```{r fig-gb}
#| fig-cap: "Value added for girls and for boys in each school (single-sex schools show one). Attainment 8 points, against England, shrunk."
#| fig-height: !expr max(3.2, 0.42 * n + 1.8)
fig_va(w, c("girls", "boys"), title = "Girls and boys")
```

# Absence

```{r fig-abs-series}
#| fig-cap: "Overall absence, autumn and spring terms, 2016/17 to 2025/26. Sessions-weighted; 2019/20 not collected."
#| fig-height: 4.8
fig_abs_series(ser, c(NAME, COMPS), paste0(NAME, " against ", and_list(COMPS), " and England"))
```

- **`r sprintf("%.1f", s_at(NAME, abs_last))`% absence** in autumn and
  spring `r yr(abs_last)` (`r sprintf("%.1f", s_at(NAME, abs_prev))`% a
  year earlier), against `r sprintf("%.1f", s_at("England", abs_last))`%
  for England.
- **Against its intake**, on the v2.0 intake terms, the area's schools ran
  `r sprintf("%.2f", abs(abs_ex(NAME)))` points
  `r ifelse(abs_ex(NAME) >= 0, "above", "below")` what their pupils'
  profiles predict over 2021/22 to 2024/25
  (`r and_list(sprintf("%s %s", COMPS, sh(sapply(COMPS, abs_ex), 2)))`).
`r if (!nrow(over)) "- **No school** runs more than a point above its predicted absence." else if (nrow(over) <= FEW) paste0("- **", and_list(over$SCHNAME), "** ", ifelse(nrow(over) == 1, "runs", "each run"), " more than a point above ", ifelse(nrow(over) == 1, "its prediction", "their predictions"), ".") else paste0("- **", nrow(over), " schools** run more than a point above their predictions: the top of the table below.")`
`r if (!nrow(under)) "" else if (nrow(under) <= FEW) paste0("- **", and_list(under$SCHNAME), "** ", ifelse(nrow(under) == 1, "runs", "run"), " more than a point below.") else paste0("- **", nrow(under), " schools** run more than a point below: the foot of the table.")`

```{r tbl-absence}
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("Each school's absence against what its intake predicts (v2.0 intake terms, mean 2021/22 to 2024/25), and its reasons in autumn and spring ", yr(abs_last), " (percentage of sessions).")
w |>
  select(URN, SCHNAME, abs_obs, abs_exp, abs_excess) |>
  left_join(X$sch_reasons |> transmute(URN = as.integer(urn), illness, unauth_other, reduced, excluded), by = "URN") |>
  arrange(desc(abs_excess)) |>
  transmute(School = SCHNAME, `Absence %` = sprintf("%.1f", abs_obs), `Predicted by intake %` = sprintf("%.1f", abs_exp),
            `Above prediction` = sh(abs_excess), Illness = sprintf("%.1f", illness),
            Unauthorised = sprintf("%.1f", unauth_other), `Reduced timetable` = sprintf("%.2f", reduced),
            Suspended = sprintf("%.2f", excluded)) |>
  kt(align = "lrrrrrrr")
```

```{r fig-reasons}
#| fig-cap: !expr paste0("Absence by register reason, autumn and spring ", yr(abs_last), ", percentage of possible sessions. The ten largest reasons nationally.")
#| fig-height: 5
fig_reasons(rs, c(NAME, COMPS), "What the absence is")
```

**Suspensions** were `r sprintf("%.1f", ex_at(NAME))` episodes per 100
pupils in `r yr(ex_last)`, against `r sprintf("%.1f", ex_at("England"))`
for England. One pupil can be suspended several times:
`r sprintf("%.1f", ep$pupil_rate)` pupils per 100 were suspended at least
once, about `r sprintf("%.1f", ep$per_pupil)` times each, against
`r sprintf("%.1f", ex_at("England", "pupil_rate"))` per 100 and
`r sprintf("%.1f", ex_at("England", "susp_per_pupil"))` times in England.
Reduced timetables take `r sprintf("%.2f", r_at(NAME, "Reduced timetable"))`%
of sessions, `r sprintf("%.1f", rt_ratio)` times England's rate.

```{r tbl-susp}
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("Suspension episodes and pupils suspended at least once, per 100 pupils, and permanent exclusions, by school, ", yr(ex_last), ".")
X$excl_schools |> arrange(desc(susp_rate)) |>
  transmute(School = school_name, Pupils = headcount, `Suspension episodes per 100` = sprintf("%.1f", susp_rate),
            `Pupils suspended per 100` = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * one_plus / headcount),
            `Permanent exclusions` = perm_excl) |>
  kt(align = "lrrrr")
```

```{r tbl-scenario}
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("Predicted Attainment 8 gain if each school's absence fell to England's school average (", sprintf("%.1f", P$scenarios$nat_abs[1]), "%, ", yl(P$scenarios$year[1]), "), on the v2.0 absence coefficients. Indicative only.")
w |> filter(gain_all > 0) |> arrange(desc(gain_all)) |>
  transmute(School = SCHNAME, `Absence %` = sprintf("%.1f", absence),
            `Gain, all pupils` = sh(gain_all), `Gain, disadvantaged` = sh(gain_dis)) |>
  kt(align = "lrrr")
```

# Over time

```{r time-setup}
#| include: false
YRS <- va_years(V)
tyears <- sort(unique(YRS$year_label))
area_m <- YRS |> filter(URN %in% w$URN, group == "all") |> group_by(year_label) |>
  summarise(va = mean(va, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ma_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(tyears[2:(length(tyears) - 1)], function(c) centred_ma(YRS |> filter(URN %in% w$URN), c, 3))) |>
  filter(group == "all")
improved <- ma_tab |> filter(centre %in% range(centre)) |> select(URN, centre, ma) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = centre, values_from = ma) |>
  (\(x) setNames(x, c("URN", "first", "last")))() |>
  mutate(change = last - first) |> left_join(w |> select(URN, SCHNAME), by = "URN") |> arrange(desc(change))
```

Value added is computed for every year separately, then averaged. A
single year moves a good deal; a **three-year moving average centred on a
year** (that year, the one before and the one after) shows the trajectory
more steadily. Years at the ends use the years they have. 2025/26 is
provisional and shown as a hollow point. The
[explorer](@@ROOT@@explore.qmd) lets you choose the centre year and the
window.

```{r fig-area-years}
#| fig-cap: "The area's schools' average value added by year, for each pupil group, against England (zero). 2025/26 provisional."
#| fig-height: 4.6
fig_area_years(YRS, w, NAME)
```

`r if (nrow(improved) > 1) paste0("On the three-year centred average from ", yl(min(ma_tab$centre)), " to ", yl(max(ma_tab$centre)), ", the largest rises are at ", and_list(sprintf("%s (%s)", head(improved$SCHNAME, 2), sh(head(improved$change, 2)))), " and the largest falls at ", and_list(sprintf("%s (%s)", tail(improved$SCHNAME, 2), sh(tail(improved$change, 2)))), ". The later windows include the provisional 2025/26 year.") else ""`

```{r fig-trajectories}
#| fig-cap: "Each school's value added for all pupils, year by year (points; hollow is provisional 2025/26), with its three-year centred moving average (line)."
#| fig-height: !expr 1.2 + 1.7 * ceiling(n / 4)
fig_trajectories(YRS, w, "all", 3)
```

```{r tbl-ma}
#| tbl-cap: "Three-year centred moving average of value added for all pupils (Attainment 8 points), by centre year; the last includes provisional 2025/26."
mt <- ma_tab |> left_join(w |> select(URN, SCHNAME), by = "URN") |>
  mutate(centre = paste0(yl(centre), if_else(includes_provisional, " (incl. prov.)", ""))) |>
  select(School = SCHNAME, centre, ma) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = centre, values_from = ma)
mt[order(-mt[[ncol(mt)]]), ] |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~sprintf("%+.1f", .x))) |>
  kt(align = paste0("l", strrep("r", ncol(mt) - 1)))
```

# Questions for discussion

```{r questions}
#| results: asis
u_dis <- d_get(NAME, "Disadvantaged", "Unexplained (school)")
abs_piece <- d_get(NAME, "All pupils", "Absence")
best_dis <- w |> filter(va_shrunk_disadvantaged > 0) |> arrange(desc(va_shrunk_disadvantaged))
q <- c(
  paste0("**Disadvantaged pupils.** Their value added averages ", sh(m("disadvantaged")), " points across ", NAME,
         "'s schools against ", sh(m("non_disadvantaged")), " for other pupils. ",
         if (nrow(best_dis)) paste0(ifelse(nrow(best_dis) == 1, "What does ", "What do "), and_list(head(best_dis$SCHNAME, 3)),
                                    ", above expectation for them, do that others could share?")
         else "No school here is above expectation for them; what do schools elsewhere with similar intakes do differently?"),
  if (abs_piece < -1 || abs_ex(NAME) > 1) paste0("**Attendance is a lever here.** Absence costs ", sprintf("%.1f", abs(abs_piece)),
    " points against England, and the area's schools run ", sprintf("%.1f", abs_ex(NAME)), " points above what their intakes predict.")
  else if (abs_piece < -0.3 || abs_ex(NAME) > 0.5) paste0("**Attendance is a modest lever.** Absence costs ", sprintf("%.1f", abs(abs_piece)),
    " points against England.")
  else "**Attendance is not the area's main lever**, though individual schools above their predicted absence are worth a look.",
  if (TIER != "region" && !UNITARY) { if (!length(sch)) "**Schools, not the place.** No district effect survives each school's own record on v2.0: the differences that matter are between schools."
    else paste0("**Something the schools share.** ", and_list(sch), " survives each school's own record. What do these schools have in common?") },
  { prac <- c(if (rt_ratio > 1.5) sprintf("reduced timetables run at %.1f times", rt_ratio),
              if (sus_ratio > 1.3) sprintf("suspension episodes run at %.1f times", sus_ratio))
    if (length(prac)) paste0("**Practice.** In ", NAME, ", ", and_list(prac), " the national rate. These are choices made within schools.")
    else "**Practice.** Reduced timetables and suspensions are close to or below the national rate." },
  if (TIER != "region") { la <- if (TIER == "la") NAME else PARENT; le <- la_at(la, "disadvantaged")
    paste0("**The authority.** ", la, "'s own v2.0 effect for disadvantaged pupils is ", sh(pct(le$effect)), "% (", ord(le$rank), " of ", le$n_la, ")",
           ifelse(le$sig, ", distinguishable from zero.", ", not distinguishable from zero.")) })
q <- q[!is.na(q) & nzchar(q)]
cat(paste0(seq_along(q), ". ", q, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

# Notes on method {.unnumbered}

Value Added v2.0 is described on [the method page](@@ROOT@@method.qmd). The
absence-against-intake measure, the district test, the trust analysis,
the attendance-counted-in value added and the scenarios are refitted on
the v2.0 specification by `R/04_place_and_absence.R`. The absence series,
reasons and suspensions are the original project's (`R/17_area_analysis.R`).
School districts come from each school's postcode. The decomposition
splits each area's mean log Attainment 8 against England's into one piece
per model term, exactly, and converts to points at England's mean. This
page is generated from `templates/area.qmd` by `R/03_area_pages.R`; the
format is recorded in `AREA_REPORTS.md`.
